description: UX quality checklist for QA verification step. Hard gate — missing items cause fail, not warning.

checks.check: Every entity has a DELETE handler in server.js AND a delete button with confirmation in app.js.
Write operations (POST/PUT/DELETE) trigger user-visible feedback (toast, alert, status message).
List views show empty state text when no data exists, with action button to create first item.
Forms validate required fields before submission with inline error display.
Async data fetches show loading indicator (spinner, skeleton, or text).
Multi-module app has persistent navigation with all modules listed and active state.
Frontend implements ALL modules defined in spec, not just the first one.
checks.method: count modules in spec vs rendered routes/views in app.js

checks.check: Every user-controlled string interpolated into HTML (innerHTML, template literals) passes through escapeHtml(). Specifically: showConfirmDialog message, ticket comments, customer names in delete dialogs.
checks.note: FAIL if any raw ${userValue} appears in innerHTML assignment.

checks.check: Status/priority badge class names use whitelist lookup, not raw interpolation of user values.
checks.note: WARN if class attributes interpolate raw status/priority.

checks.check: PUT/POST endpoints validate required fields and enum values. DELETE returns 404 for missing rows.
checks.note: Server.js must reject blank required fields and return 404 on missing delete targets.

checks.check: qa_report.json must not contradict itself. If semantic_checks marks AC-N as 'warning', acceptance_test_results MUST NOT mark the same AC-N as PASS without explanation.
checks.method: cross-reference check_id status with acceptance_test_results details.
